items.quote: “You will see it with your own eyes, but you will not eat any of it!”
items.contrast: The reader must distinguish the officer’s skeptical question from the man of God’s prediction about what the officer would experience.
items.reason: The officer merely questions whether the event could happen. The man of God predicts that the officer will see it but not eat any of it, and verse 20 explicitly says that this is exactly what happened to him.
